author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Current drawing had a square paddle head with a U cut-out that read as a fly swatter or spatula, not a toothbrush. Redrawn as a side-view toothbrush on the reference's 45-degree diagonal: long straight handle and three bristle tufts rising from the head. Reads as a toothbrush at 48 in both themes.
omissions: Outlined head capsule and handle neck bend dropped; bristles drawn as tufts instead of lines inside the head (no room for 8-unit spacing inside a capsule).
